title: Diffusive synchronization of phase waves in the FitzHugh-Nagumo system
summary: We analyze synchronization of relaxation oscillations in multiple-timescale reaction-diffusion systems. Interpreting synchronization as convergence to frequency-synchronized wave-train solutions, we resolve for the first time the case of phase waves. These waves are nearly phase-synchronized relaxation oscillations, featuring quasistationary plateaus of length $\varepsilon^{-1}$ separated by fast transition layers, where $\varepsilon\ll1$ is the timescale separation parameter.
